user_statement: I confirm my explicit USER_ACCEPTED decision for Phase 6 Subphase 8, based on the completed independent technical validation.
scientific_limitations_to_carry_forward: No wholly locally-undetected campaign subset exists in the verified VAL inventory; no claim of federated rescue on that empty subset.
Campaign detection anywhere, all-targeted detection, organization trials, local User occurrences, User-time decisions and detection time are different endpoints.
VAL was used for model selection and calibration; these are not held-out TEST results.
The 1% empirical FPR belongs only to the frozen eligible fixed-grid VAL negative denominator, not arbitrary event/campaign false-positive rates.
Shared backgrounds and three temporal blocks per split induce dependence; no naive IID confidence intervals or cross-organization identity deduplication.
Temporal alert attribution is association, not causal proof; unattributed alerts are not automatically confirmed false positives.
Finite horizon and right-censoring remain unchanged; full final-ten-minute operational coverage is preserved.
Keep Raccount/Sorg controlled design families separate; target coverage, per-User intensity, total volume and organization composition can differ.
Single-organization Raccount is N/A; RIP measures distinct attacker IPs per attempt, not chronological switching frequency.
Zero-delay suspicious-IP sharing is a separate comparison baseline, not realistic network latency or the federated architecture.
No post-hoc dataset, campaign-intensity, model, threshold, label, split or attribution changes to manufacture sub-threshold campaigns.
The graph/model/sampler remain local and unchanged; future federation must use compatible common architecture without rewriting accepted local checkpoints.
preservation: All original outputs, prior failed review, independent audit, SQLite databases/sidecars, model/threshold bundles, labels, protocols, Excel workbooks and evidence remain unchanged.
